title: 26 in. 208 cc Gas Walk Behind 3-In-1 Wide Area Self Propelled Lawn Mower, Rear Wheel Drive with Blade Brake Clutch
description:
Description
This 26 in. mower is ideal for homeowners on-the-go with large yards. Reduce your mowing time and cover more ground is less time with this 208 cc Turf Beast walk behind mower. Self-propelled fixed speed rear wheel drive.
Cuts grass 24% faster than equivalent 21 models
26 in. W cutting deck – blade 25-7/8 in.
Light weight combined with a powerful engine allows easy maneuverability on uneven terrain and slopes
3-in-1 features include rear bag, side discharge and mulching
Designed for convenience, this mower comes with the blade brake clutch which stops the cutting blade while keeping the engine running so you can empty bag without restarting
9-3/4 in. front and rear wheels
Covers a wide area
